mapper.select: SELECT m.FINPROD_ID finprodId, m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, n.TYPE_6 type6, n.TYPE_7 type7, m.mdate, m.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, m.COUPON_SPECIES couponSpecies, m.IS_SUS isSus, m.IS_RIGHT isRight, (SELECT DISTINCT YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R1 WHERE FINPROD_ID =${secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and BRANCH =0 AND (R1.EFF_DATE = (SELECT max(EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R2 WHERE R1.CASH_ID =R2.CASH_ID AND R2.EFF_DATE <= #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE}) OR R1.EFF_DATE>#{valDate,jdbcType=DATE})) AS paperYield, (SELECT DISTINCT INT_TYPE FROM FIN_RATE_INFO R1 WHERE FINPROD_ID =${secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and BRANCH =0 AND (R1.EFF_DATE = (SELECT max(EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_RATE_INFO R2 WHERE R1.CASH_ID =R2.CASH_ID AND R2.EFF_DATE <= #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE}) OR R1.EFF_DATE>#{valDate,jdbcType=DATE})) AS intType from FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE n ON m.FINPROD_ID =n.FINPROD_ID AND n.BRANCH =0 where m.FINPROD_ID = ${secid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select min(EXERCISE_DATE) nextExerDate from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN m where EXERCISE_TYPE ='02' AND FINPROD_ID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and EXERCISE_DATE >=#{valDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.SMV prinAmt, T3.TYPE_8 assetType FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT PTL_ID , MAX(VAL_DATE) VAL_DATE FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB WHERE VAL_DATE <= #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY PTL_ID ) T2 ON T1.VAL_DATE = T2.VAL_DATE AND T1.PTL_ID = T2.PTL_ID INNER join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T3 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID AND BRANCH =0 where SUB_CODE like '_________%' AND T1.PTL_ID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL

select t1.FINPROD_ID prodId, t1.MDATE mdate, t1.OPERATION_TYPE operationType, t2.TYPE_6 prodSeries, t2.TYPE_7 prodType, t4.OPEN_TYPE openType, t4.OPEN_DAYS_TYPE openDaysType, t4.OPEN_MODE openMode, t5.CLOSE_DAYS closeDays, t4.OPEN_CYCLE openCycle, t4.OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT openCycleUnit from FIN_PRODUCT t1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t2 ON t1.FINPROD_ID =t2.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD t5 ON t1.FINPROD_ID =t5.FINPROD_ID left JOIN (select n.*,m.FINPROD_ID from FIN_CASH_INFO m inner join FIN_OPEN_RULE n ON m.CASH_ID=n.CASH_ID and m.CASH_TYPE_1='01' AND m.CASH_TYPE_2='C01' ) t4 on t4.FINPROD_ID=t1.FINPROD_ID where t1.FINPROD_ID = #{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT nvl(OPEN_DATE_STR,#{caldate,jdbcType=DATE}) openVdate FROM (SELECT m.FINPROD_ID,y.OPEN_DATE_STR ,rank() over(PARTITION BY m.FINPROD_ID ORDER BY y.OPEN_DATE_STR asc) AS rowno from FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO n ON n.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID AND n.CASH_TYPE_1='01' AND n.CASH_TYPE_2='C01' INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN y ON y.CASH_ID=n.CASH_ID AND y.OPEN_TYPE IN ('02','03') WHERE m.FINPROD_ID =#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND y.OPEN_DATE_STR>#{caldate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY y.OPEN_DATE_STR ASC) WHERE rowno=1

SELECT DISTINCT y.INVESTMENT_CYCLE from FIN_PRODUCT m INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO n ON n.FINPROD_ID=m.FINPROD_ID AND n.CASH_TYPE_1='01' AND n.CASH_TYPE_2='C01' INNER JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT y ON m.FINPROD_ID=y.FINPROD_ID WHERE m.FINPROD_ID =#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select info.FINPROD_ID finprodId,info.mdate , psp.HUGE_RED_RATIO maxRedRate, sum(DECODE(deal.PS,'C4',NVL(deal.SHARE_AMT,deal.PRIN_AMT)*-1,NVL(deal.SHARE_AMT,deal.PRIN_AMT)) ) prinAmt from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join FIN_PRODUCT info on deal.FINPROD_ID =info.FINPROD_ID left join PRD_SALE_PARAM psp on deal.FINPROD_ID =psp.FINPROD_ID where deal.TRADE_STATUS !='03' AND deal.IS_CANCEL ='N' and deal.TRADE_DATE <=#{caldate,jdbcType=DATE} and info.FINPROD_ID = #{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by info.FINPROD_ID,info.MDATE ,psp.HUGE_RED_RATIO having sum(deal.TRADE_AMT)>50000

SELECT M_DURATION mDuration,SDURATION sDuration,INTEREST_DURATION interestDuration FROM (SELECT SEC_ID,M_DURATION,SDURATION,INTEREST_DURATION,VALUE_SOURCE,CASE WHEN n.TRADE_MARKET ='01' THEN RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY SEC_ID ORDER BY VALUE_SOURCE ASC,VALUE_DATE DESC ) ELSE RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY SEC_ID ORDER BY VALUE_SOURCE DESC,VALUE_DATE DESC ) END AS rowno FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO m inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT n ON m.SEC_ID =n.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE VALUE_DATE<=#{valDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND n.FINPROD_ID =#{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE rowno=1

SELECT TO_DATE(HOLIDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') HOLIDATE FROM (SELECT HOLIDATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY HOLIDATE DESC) RN FROM SRC_HOLIDAY WHERE EFFECTFLAG='W' AND MARKET_CODE=DECODE(#{marketcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'SH','SY','SZ','SY',#{marketcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND HOLIDATE<=TO_CHAR(#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE},'YYYY-MM-DD')) WHERE RN=5 ORDER BY RN ASC

SELECT DISTINCT FINPROD_ID finprodId, PORTFOLIO_ID prodId, TYPE_8 assetType, CASE WHEN TYPE_8 = 'F01'AND SUM(TRADE_AMT)<0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(TRADE_AMT) END prinAmt,MDATE FROM ( select NULL AS FINPROD_ID,NULL AS PORTFOLIO_ID, TRADE_AMT,'XJ' AS TYPE_8,NULL AS MDATE from ( SELECT sum(RVALUE) TRADE_AMT FROM (select nvl(sum(AMOUNT),0) as RVALUE from PTL_CASH_POSITION where PORTFOLIO_ID in ${prodid} and HODING_TYPE='03' and CDATE =date'${valDate}' UNION ALL select nvl(sum(AMOUNT),0) as RVALUE from PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW where PORTFOLIO_ID in ${prodid} and HODING_TYPE='01' and CDATE =date'${valDate}' ) ) UNION ALL select t1.FINPROD_ID,t1.PORTFOLIO_ID,nvl(MARKET_VALUE,0)+nvl(TDY_INTINCEXP,0) as TRADE_AMT,t3.TYPE_8,t2.MDATE from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION t1 inner join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID INNER join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t3 on t1.FINPROD_ID = t3.FINPROD_ID AND t3.BRANCH =0 AND TYPE_8 IN ('F01','F04','F06','F02','F11') where t1.PORTFOLIO_ID in ${prodid} and t1.CDATE = date'${valDate}'-1 UNION ALL select t1.FINPROD_ID,t1.PORTFOLIO_ID, nvl(MARKET_VALUE,0)+nvl(TDY_INTINCEXP,0) as TRADE_AMT,t3.TYPE_8,t2.MDATE from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION t1 inner join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT t2 on t1.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID AND t2.BRANCH=0 INNER join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t3 on t1.FINPROD_ID = t3.FINPROD_ID AND t3.BRANCH =0 AND t3.TYPE_8 IN ('F07','F10') where t1.PORTFOLIO_ID in ${prodid} and t1.CDATE = date'${valDate}'-1 UNION ALL select n.FINPROD_ID ,t4.PORTFOLIO_ID, nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T01',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T04',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T52',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T02',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T03',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T19',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T07',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T08',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T09',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T22',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T23',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T11',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T46',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T47',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T48',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T39',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) as TRADE_AMT,t3.TYPE_8,t2.MDATE from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL n INNER join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on n.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID INNER join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t3 on n.FINPROD_ID = t3.FINPROD_ID AND t3.BRANCH =0 AND TYPE_8 IN ('F01','F04','F06','F02','F11') inner JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD t4 ON n.TRADE_ID=t4.TRADE_ID where t4.PORTFOLIO_ID in ${prodid} and n.TRADE_DATE = date'${valDate}' and ( (TYPE_8='F04'and n.ps!='T06') OR (TYPE_8!='F04')) and ((TYPE_8='F02'and n.ps!='T06') OR (TYPE_8!='F02')) and n.PS in ('T01','T02','T03','T04','T19','T07','T08','T09','T11','T22','T23','T52','T46','T47','T48','T39') group by t4.PORTFOLIO_ID,n.FINPROD_ID,t2.MDATE,t3.TYPE_8 UNION ALL select n.FINPROD_ID ,t4.PORTFOLIO_ID, nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T01',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T04',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T52',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T02',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T03',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T06',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T07',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T08',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) TRADE_AMT,t3.TYPE_8,t2.MDATE from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL n inner join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT t2 on n.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID INNER join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t3 on n.FINPROD_ID = t3.FINPROD_ID AND t3.BRANCH =0 AND TYPE_8 IN ('F07','F10') inner JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD t4 ON n.TRADE_ID=t4.TRADE_ID where t4.PORTFOLIO_ID in ${prodid} and n.TRADE_DATE = date'${valDate}' and n.PS in ('T01','T02','T03','T04','T06','T07','T08','T09','T11','T22','T23','T52') group by t4.PORTFOLIO_ID,n.FINPROD_ID,t2.MDATE,t3.TYPE_8 UNION ALL select n.FINPROD_ID ,m.PORTFOLIO_ID, nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T01',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T04',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T52',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T02',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T23',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) -nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T11',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T46',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) +nvl(sum(decode(n.PS,'T47',decode(TRADE_STATUS,'03',n.TRADE_AMT*-1,n.TRADE_AMT))),0) T2.FINPROD_ID=n.FINPROD_ID INNER join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t3 on n.FINPROD_ID = t3.FINPROD_ID AND t3.BRANCH =0 AND TYPE_8 IN ('F01','F04','F06','F02','F11') WHERE m.PORTFOLIO_ID in ${prodid} AND n.TRADE_DATE=date'${valDate}' and ( (TYPE_8='F04'and n.ps!='T06') OR (TYPE_8!='F04')) and ((TYPE_8='F02'and n.ps!='T06') OR (TYPE_8!='F02')) and n.PS in ('T01','T02','T03','T04','T19','T07','T08','T09','T11','T22','T23','T52','T46','T47','T48') group by m.PORTFOLIO_ID,n.FINPROD_ID,t2.MDATE,t3.TYPE_8 UNION ALL select n.FINPROD_ID ,m.PORTFOLIO_ID,
